generationTool: Original concept boards: built-in image_gen; native previews: Avalonia

assetReuse.userDirection: Reuse modular stopwatch frames across different pages and panel sizes instead of generating a new PNG frame for each surface.

verifiedCurrentState.currentMethod: Shared modular recipes: uniform-scale fixed ornaments, repeated and clipped rails, assembled interior clips, per-frame content insets, and a bounded 32-layout cache.
verifiedCurrentState.bitmapCache: Shared by stopwatch overlays and previews, keyed by resource path.
verifiedCurrentState.conceptBoards: Design references outside the Desktop Assets resource directory; not production window images.

assetReuse.proposedApproach: Reuse the current catalog through a shared modular frame component. All artwork pieces keep one uniform scale; corners and ornaments stay fixed, rails repeat, and the last repeat is clipped to fit. No artwork stretching. Backgrounds remain independent reusable assets. Avoid per-page or per-size frame bitmap exports.
assetReuse.noStretchRequirement: User rejected the nine-slice preview: no stretching please. This applies to edges and ornaments as well as corners.
assetReuse.settingsBoundary: Sharing artwork does not require sharing appearance preferences; no global synchronization policy has been approved.
assetReuse.validationNeeded: Physical monitor DPI remains untested. Future picker rows, typography and controls remain separate design layers.
assetReuse.implementationStatus: Integrated into the production overlay, inspector previews, reusable panel surface and Nika clock picker. Native regressions and production-resolution audit passed; no new runtime frame assets. Installed application unchanged.

nativePreview.finding: One existing frame renders at all three sizes. Corner proportions remain fixed; decorative side sections stretch on tall panels and need a modular edge refinement before adoption.
nativePreview.status: Rejected by user because side artwork stretches; preserved as baseline.

modularPreview.finding: All six ornaments keep their size and proportions. Uniformly scaled rail segments repeat with end clipping; no artwork is stretched. Same existing PNG reused at all sizes.
modularPreview.status: User accepted the improved no-stretch preview; native prototype is not yet integrated into the application.
modularPreview.userFeedback: yea that's much better. but I think some of the frames has more work than this.
modularPreview.nextStepProposal: Audit all 16 frame styles for fixed pieces, repeatable edges, custom ornament placement, joins and minimum sizes; review native three-size comparisons before consolidating the shared renderer.

catalogAudit.execution: Isolated native Avalonia harness on a private desktop, without app windows or settings access.
catalogAudit.status: Geometry checks passed; catalog is not visually approved or production-ready.
priorityRefinements: Tide Curve: broken wave phase and abrupt clipped joins.
Admiralty: corner fan cuts and rail transitions.
Vine Filigree: leaf tips need tailored rail connectors.
Royal Cartouche: corner and side-crest transitions; header clearance.
catalogAudit.nextStep: Refine the four priority recipes and compare their joins at the same three sizes before consolidating the shared production renderer.

changes: Tide Curve: whole reflected wave repeats with variable-length level troughs; short overlap into the original right ornament.
Admiralty: separate fan tips and diamond flares, with straight inner and outer rail strips.
Vine Filigree: move stem cuts between curls and overlap the rails with softly blended ornament exits.
Royal Cartouche: retain complete corner curls and taller side crests, with overlapping rail connections.
joinRefinement.captureNote: Direct non-96-DPI offscreen targets displaced transformed pieces and double-scaled text. Explicit context scale into 96-DPI targets gives correct native 1.5x/2x exports; pixel coverage comparisons guard against that failure. Physical monitor DPI remains untested.
joinRefinement.status: Refined native prototypes ready for user review; not integrated into the application.
joinRefinement.nextStep: Settle frame visuals, then consolidate the shared renderer with per-style background clipping, content insets and minimum-size rules.

productionIntegration.execution: All native and unit-test windows confined to private Windows desktops; no active desktop interaction.
productionIntegration.behavior: 70% background and 40% inactive defaults preserved. Heavy ornaments may add overlay height to preserve font size and content clearance. Picker keeps independent frame/material choices and existing row styling.
productionIntegration.review: Independent review identified a Tide Curve mask issue; RED regression reproduced it, contiguous interior spans preserved, and translated geometry uses NonZero fill to prevent opacity seams. Final native regression and 1x/1.5x/2x mask checks passed.
limitations: Physical monitor DPI not exercised; explicit native render scales were tested.
Frame placements and masks are cached; cropped image operations replay per paint. No frame-rate improvement claim.
Build prepared locally; no commit, push or live installation.

existingBehavior: Lists all sessions in current session order.

notes: Generated concept boards are references only; native audit boards use the documented fixture dimensions.
Both boards have been inspected for six correct clocks, times, order, running/paused markers, active clock and focus marker in every option.
Surface-board frame and material combinations are proposals; no new retained collections or picker opacity settings are approved yet.

Shared production frame infrastructure is integrated. Earlier preview and refinement blocks preserve the historical design stages; current status and evidence are in productionIntegration. User app settings were not changed.
